thread:
Maya (Content): starting a short sprint to produce 4 compact developer tutorials + 1 cloneable reference app. audience: engineers who want a drop-in example for Redwood API.
Leo (DevRel): ++. recommend Next.js, Flask, Rails, and a minimal Go example. I'll do Next + refapp.
Ravi (Marketing): timeline: webinar on Fri 10 days out. need two tutorials live + refapp demo clip by then. social plan: announcement, how-to highlight, demo clip, webinar CTA.
Maya (Content): proposed cadence: Day1 plan + templates; Day2 authoring; Day3 code + tests; Day4 review + assets; Day5 publish + promote.
Ava (Eng): I'll own Go example. will spin a tiny HTTP server that calls the API and show binary-friendly embeddings.
Sam (SEO): include slug guidance: use keywords "Redwood API quickstart", "LLM inference tutorial", and add short meta descriptions. OG image per page.
Leo (DevRel): can we add tiny video snippets (30-90s) demonstrating local run and refapp boot? I'll record. captions required.
Ravi (Marketing): creative sizes: 1200x627 for Twitter/LinkedIn, square for community posts. I'll assign a designer. also need short copy variants for paid channels.
Maya (Content): content structure: intro (what you can build in <5m), prerequisites, 4 steps, main code snippet, run & test section, and a small "benchmark note" showing simple latency numbers.
Ava (Eng): I'll add a GH Action that smoke-tests the sample flow on PRs (curl + mocked key).
Leo (DevRel): sample curl for tutorials:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-chat-medium","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"summarize this repo"}] }'
```
Maya (Content): inbound routing: tutorial downloads/clone -> community nurture list; webinar registrants -> sales-assisted if enterprise domain. Ravi confirm?
Ravi (Marketing): confirmed. also add hidden field capturing "use_case" to funnel intent. utm: utm_source=community&utm_campaign=tutorials_sprint.
Sam (SEO): please add canonical links for repo README to avoid duplicate copy issues. also ensure code blocks have proper language markers for highlighting.
Maya (Content): owners: Next.js + refapp: Leo; Flask: Maya; Rails: Ravi (with engineering pair); Go: Ava. Videos: Leo. QA: all authors.
Ava (Eng): license note: MIT for code examples, add CONTRIBUTING and basic CODE_OF_CONDUCT for refapp repo.
Leo (DevRel): deploy keys? @secrets-bot who stores staging keys?
secrets-bot: staging_shared_key available in #secrets-ops. access: marketing/devrel/read-only. rotated last week.
Ravi (Marketing): promotional schedule suggestion: Day0 announce (short post), Day2 tutorial deep-dive, Day4 refapp demo clip, Day7 webinar reminder + last-chance.
Maya (Content): QA checklist: run samples with staging key, capture screenshots, verify build instructions, check links & UTM, add alt text to images, add captions to videos.
Leo (DevRel): will upload demo clip and sample repo by EOD Day3. I'll include README with quickstart and a feedback form (checkboxes: tried demo / integrating / need enterprise).
Sam (SEO): I'll prep SEO titles + meta templates once drafts are in.
Maya (Content): any blockers?
Ava (Eng): need brief review from runtime team on the benchmark numbers before publish. flag as "placeholder" until confirmed.
Ravi (Marketing): noted. we'll mark benchmark text as preliminary.
Maya (Content): great. I'll make the Notion board and PR templates now and tag owners. link will be posted here.
Leo (DevRel): :rocket: let's ship it.
text_snippet: sprint to produce 4 dev tutorials + refapp. owners assigned (Next.js, Flask, Rails, Go). publish timeline aligned to upcoming webinar. inbound routing: tutorials->community nurture; webinar->sales for enterprise domains. QA + CI + SEO tasks assigned.
